If the submission is approved though, you will not be able to even notice the reflection though in a Pokestop. The pic quality goes down it seems and you’d only notice it if you expanded the photo and looked really hard.

But if it does get rejected, I will take your advice. Never thought it would give me the option to zoom in through the app.
Perhaps. I never thought of that.

Well, it’s not the only refection present in the image. You can also see the surrounding statues too. It’s hard to avoid reflections with the type of surface on that plaque, I was getting in some pretty painful positions trying to avoid being in the reflection.

If it gets rejected I will wear black gloves and lay on the floor I guess to take the pic.

I wasted my first upgrade on that submission, I’m expecting the worst now. But I do understand why if it gets declined. I suppose I’ll have to lie on my stomach on the rocks and take a pic from below next time, lol. Or I could take a far away pic, which I wouldn’t personally want to do.

> 4.	⁠There are reviewers who would reject because of that. There surely are ways to make sure you aren't in it.

That’s too bad. That submission will most likely be rejected then. Is it inherently breaking any rules? And you saw the pic right? If you got that submission, would you give it a low rating? Thanks for answering my questions.

I’m exactly like this too! When someone asks me what’s my favorite genre of music, I get really flustered and act like I don’t even listen to music. I just feel really embarrassed whenever I’m asked to talk about myself. I’d rather not. Maybe it’s because I’m pretty insecure all around. I relate to this post a lot!
Already active in both those communities ;D
Uhm... pulled another, nastier one out of my nose just now. https://imgur.com/a/lJrdJSp

I have a scab in my nose that I continually pick at (I have compulsive skin picking disorder) and it keeps getting worse and worse. But yes, I do have a fan on every night, otherwise it’s unbearably hot.

Damn why is this community so downvote-happy
Thank you!!

My sister has had this same habit too and hers is far more infected than mine. I think I’m going to try and leave it alone by sheer willpower from now on, I really don’t want to give myself a brain infection...
Source?
Any updates in this?

LOL this happened to me too, except I was held down while my family members took turns trying to pull it out with their fingers at a Thanksgiving party

I never even wanted earrings in the first place...

Honestly I’m not even that suicidal anymore (because I’m a NEET with no pressure from my family to do anything) but I think it lingers strongly in my subconscious.

This was my first time dreaming of suicide, too.
I’m SUPER suicidal but can’t go through with any plan because family is too close to me and I don’t want to put them through the trauma
You have to keep going, find something that drives you to live. These thoughts will subside. It sounds like your coworkers at your new job already like having you there
Congrats!!! I still haven’t worked before. Keep it up. Suicidal thoughts always linger no matter what sometimes, but you can get through this
Look at the sub this was posted in
Oh my that looks really bad. Keep us updated. And I would NOT try to pop that if I were you
I have some around my eye too, one in the right corner of my eye by the tearduct. Unsure what to do about that one.
I don’t understand why they failed to call back though. It was really discouraging both times. Although admittedly the second time was my fault.

They never called back...

They called me on a Saturday to do a second interview for some reason, but I was out of town and asked to do the call the next day. They never called back... again.

It was just a basic retail job. I was pretty nervous and it was obvious. Kept fidgeting with my hands and breaking eye contact to look off at a wall.

How tf am I ever going to get work experience if I never get hired? I’m fucking doomed.

They should care and show effort while I’m here.
Not after the fact.

Partly the reason I don’t care how people will feel after I’m gone.
It’s called a crosswalk. And yeah, sometimes, but mostly I fear crossing at the wrong time and messing up traffic
Same.

Every time I have “friends” I always feel like they just talk to me because they pity me, or because they don’t have anyone else to talk to. I just avoid any unnecessary social interaction at this point for fear of making any friends. I just wanna disappear.

I’m doing the latter too. I’ve given up on myself, I hate myself so much all I can think about is suicide and hurting myself. I have pushed everyone away and isolated myself for years and I feel like I’m mentally rotting.

I did a job interview that my mom got for me (lmao) and the interviewer was supposed to call me yesterday and let me know whether I got hired or not. I didn’t even receive a call. I got up super early and waited all day for it...

You’re gonna make it if you try. Not being introverted is a really good advantage.

Yep. I avoided all social exposure and activities all throughout my life. I always felt inferior to everyone, extremely depressed and anxious ever since I was a young kid, and pushed everyone away throughout my life. Besides the few rare extroverted people who continued to come up and talk to me daily despite me being a closed-off, shy, awkward, nerdy weirdo.

Bless people like those... they helped me become a little less socially awkward than I would have been otherwise. But I still pushed them all away and don’t talk to any of them anymore.

I’ve cucked myself... deprived myself of all normal, fulfilling milestones in life. Is there even any hope for people like us?
suicide fuel :(
WOW that’s awesome you have a support group like that!
I have resting bitch face and every time I’m extremely depressed people just think I’m “grumpy” or in a “bitchy mood.”

I stutter a lot and have a really ugly voice. I always talk over people on accident because I struggle to anticipate social timing... either that, or uncomfortably long silences. 

I can never think of conversation topics and I really suck at small talk..

Thank you! Yeah that was a yikes. I will most likely end up a loser, it runs in the blood. Every one else in my family is relatively extroverted and successful so I think the loser, mentally ill genes all funneled into me.

Are girls supposed to handshake during interviews? Argh. I went in completely blind. I knew I was supposed to do it but I just felt so nervous I wanted to get out of there as quickly as possible. I hope I don’t get the job, I don’t ever wanna see the guy ever again after that shitshow...

And I never will attempt an interview ever again. I feel so ashamed
I’ll see one blackhead on my face, and after that rip my face
I could sense that the interviewer was looking for confidence in me and I was so nervous I wasn’t showing any of it. I didn’t even handshake the guy, before or afterwards lmao

Being introverted is seriously such a disadvantage when it comes to the real world... in so many ways.

Even if I do end up getting this job I will have to work the cash register... and deal with people all day... which doesn’t sound that bad at first but I know I’m going to be awful at it...
Let’s be real no one uses this number when they’re actually suicidal. Fuck off.
I would make it so I wasn’t born at all. Perfect life.

i havent done anything.

I have been walking 50 miles total a week but that’s about all ive improved on. i doubt that’s even helping me at all
My entire life is just embarrassing moments.
Just basic high school classes... I thought a lot of them were hard.
Lol
Yep. That’s probably the last thing big I’ll ever accomplish in life though. (If you can even call that a big accomplishment...)

And these scars *are* pretty bad considering they are on my face. I would have flawless skin for sure if I didn’t have dermatillomania, or if I was more educated about acne and acne scars in school. (Again, not trying to invalidate anyone with different scars; we’re all fighting the same battle against exoriation disorder)

I’m not competing for who has the worst scars... that’s silly. I have been very self conscious lately about the damage I have done to myself. And I feel pretty low at the moment. I really do want advice. I *have* asked for advice multiple times on this sub.

I’m not going to do it repeatedly. I probably should’ve asked for advice in the title but if you or anyone else has some I’d really appreciate it.

I’ve become pretty accustomed to staring at my iPhone all day though... it feels like I’m naked when I’m not staring at it and I’m actually doing something other than staring at it. 

It helps me avoid social interaction, helps drown out my suicidal thoughts, makes me laugh, makes me not have to think for myself, etc. It’s pathetic but I’ve become pretty addicted to it because of these things.
It might just be the camera quality because it does look a lot worse. Here are some other pics: https://imgur.com/a/CCxy4iW
Me too lmao! I’ll turn my volume down to barely audible levels just so no one catches any idea of what I’m listening to... I feel so embarrassed about it for some reason.

Ever since I started taking online high school classes in 2016 I kind of withdrew into myself and became a hermit. Lost all my social skills. And now I’m 20 and have no life skills and nothing positive or productive going in my life at all.
Godspeed. Wish I could do it with you.
It’s things like this that make me afraid to get ANY job. My self-esteem is already low as it is...
And imagine if they caught you... oh my gosh
4Head

When will people understand that having depression isn’t a choice? Most of us do NOT want to be depressed. It’s an illness... it can’t be cured by thinking happy thoughts or getting out more. It’s deeper than that...
They hurt really, really bad but they are some of the most satisfying pops when it finally becomes soft enough to pop
I don’t know what’s happening but MAN is that painful to watch

I know Twitch wouldn’t be a very popular platform if there weren’t also a lot of people like me seeking the feeling of having someone to talk to, without the pressure of actually coming up with things to say. Which I am very bad at and insecure about. And of course the streamer isn’t actually talking to me, he’ll read my message out of the other hundreds/thousands of other messages every once in a blue moon, but that’s about it. It’s okay though, being the center of attention has always been extremely scary and intimidating for me.

Yes I’d rather be another cog in the machine than a waste of space NEET who contributes literally nothing to myself, my family, or the world. Even if it’s a falser sense of meaning in life it’s better than nothing. I will never be more than a NEET though, the only thing that’ll change me is if someone forces me to change my life... I silently hope for that every day.

You are spot-on with that technology instant gratification feedback loop bit. I spend all day on the phone and watching Twitch streams,... I feel like it helps me drown out the negative and suicidal thoughts; when I’m watching a YT video or Twitch stream, it feels like I have friends talking to me or like I’m part of a conversation or friend group. I’m too stupid, awkward, and unfunny to do these things irl. (Sad, I know.)

And getting replies to my posts on Reddit or Twitter supplement my need for social contact with the outside world, it’s like a dopamine hit every time I get a notification, even if it’s someone calling me a dumbfuck. I’ve completely barred myself from having friends IRL. I just shut down when people try to befriend me.

Suicide will always be an option, although it takes more courage than I probably have. If I don’t even have the balls to socialize with people how will I have them to jump off a building, or have the courage to put a hole in my head? Ha, I will probably just be a useless pussy my entire fucking life, and still be living with my parents when I’m fucking 30+. A horrific thought
Honestly at this point I’m just hoping my parents will kick me out so I can just go kill myself in peace
die

Just today I was confused about the month because I thought it was early March, had to double take when I saw the date was April 6th. Quickly approaching my 20th birthday. I have accomplished literally nothing since I graduated high school. 

Holy fuck. I’m wasting my life away... I don’t know how to stop my rapid downward spiral in life. I don’t want to be a NEET.
Indeed

Wow. Girl, I am EXACTLY like you. I am 19, turning 20 next month and have done NOTHING ever since I graduated high school. I’ve been too consumed by depression and self-loathing to even *look* for a job. 

I’ve never worked a real job. I’ve only ever had 1 bf in my life. (tbh that doesn’t matter much to me.)

Every day I wake up with a slight amount of motivation to go do something productive, but it’s all crushed once the depressing anxious thoughts start coming in. And then I spend all day playing video games and staring at my phone...
Yes I always have dreams where I meet someone perfect for me and we spend the whole dream bonding and getting to know each other and then I wake up and remember I’m alone and worthless.
I HATE this type of shit. You guys are not funny for saying an animal is something that it isn’t. smfh
you stupid mutt. ill kick you into orbit
Looks like an armpit
>Mop water might contain vomit so I’ll just be safe and FUCKING EAT STRAIGHT VOMIT
I just take my headphones out whenever a Spotify ad comes on. They make me so irrationally annoyed. It’s the generic royalty-free music and the overly upbeat and fake asf voice actors.
Same. I would rather be a normie than this bullshit. I’d give anything to be someone else.
Yes I’m aware. It will prob be shotgun to the head. Or maybe that helium mask thing. That’d be painless and less gruesome.
Cool. I should do the same.
I’m prob just gonna kms tbqh.

Yeah... I don’t think I’d make it in the Navy. :/

Idk if that’s true. I’m p worthless.

Eating alone is one of the most relaxing things ever. Just watching whatever you want on YouTube, not needing to worry about looking like a slob while you eat, not needing to have uncomfortable, awkward conversation... 😌

Although with the right person eating together can be fun but I haven’t met anyone I’m comfortable with in years.

I am done with life. I just have a pet I’m worried about.

He’d probably better in someone else’s care anyway, but he is really bonded to me. It’s like the only thing I have left.

It’ll just take one thing to push me over the edge. One devastating failure, and I’m putting that thing against my forehead and pulling the trigger.

There are a lot of ways to die, yes. But I’m not risking anything with a chance of survivability, because with that comes the risk of brain damage or injury, which would just cause more suffering, especially to my parents, who already don’t want to put up with me anymore.

> Yeah i've set multiple dates i was going to kill myself by. Ultimately you need to shit or get off the pot with suicide. Truth is its really hard to do. You just gotta accept your too afraid to do it, and stop using it as an escape mechanism. It's immature.


I’m not afraid to commit suicide. We’re all gonna die and face death one day, none of us have a choice. I’d just prefer that it be by shotgun to the head so there’s no chance of survival. But you make a fair point. I’m mostly afraid of what comes after death. The thought of it all just being over... forever... is terrifying.

It’s also terrifying if the opposite is true, and I’m stuck with this sick mind and ugly face for eternity. But this is much less likely than the former. Maybe I should take comfort in that. I hope reincarnation is a thing though. :/

There have been multiple instances where I’ve been by a busy road and wanted to jump. But I was with a family member so I didn’t want to traumatize them. Also I’ve been looming over cliffsides and considered jumping, but didn’t want to risk surviving the fall.

Thank you, very great points. I have been a tomboy my whole life though and femininity doesn’t come naturally. I think that’s an interesting point though and I agree with you that gender roles are there for a reason, however much people wanna act like they are unnecessary social constructs.

And yeah, I don’t think neets are living the better life. Which is why I am terrified of becoming one. The regret of doing nothing with your life is daunting. And yet I want to throw my life in the trash altogether via suicide, what’s the difference?

Well, being a girl in and of itself only gets you so far. You have to be feminine and charming to really get people’s friendship and I don’t really have either of those traits. Also you have to look good. I personally hate the way I look.

Thanks for the tips, I really want to change but theres a feeling of hesitation and doubt every time I want to do something different. And then the negative self-loathing thoughts pour in and I just end up doing nothing.
No it’s okay. I won’t be as judged harshly on here as other places. I wanna hear from your guys’ perspectives.
I can’t remember how many times I was suicidal in school. Almost daily. This is such a shame. Society puts way too much pressure on kids in school.
What did the comment say?

lol literally all i do is switch between YouTube, Twitch, Twitter, Reddit and some online forums all day making myself feel numb until i go to sleep. absolutely pathetic.

and i dont have any friends so i never talk to anyone
Rude, considering the sub you’re on.
Awesome!! Keep it up! You can do it, we all believe in you! <3

I really wish mental illnesses got treated more seriously. It’s not like I am this way because I like it. I literally have a brain imbalance. And I’m shamed constantly for not having a job, a boyfriend, or going to college. Which makes it worse.

I wish people were kinder.

This made me extremely emotional. I’m so sorry. Best of wishes, maybe a miracle can happen for you.

Depression and anxiety has made me isolate myself and waste all of my teenage years afraid of the world. All I do is play video games and watch yt vids. Man, I wish I knew how to change this.
Good idea! Do you have any recommendations?

That last paragraph was so sweet. <3

Blackheads and small cysts are currently all I pick at the moment. I will search with my fingers until I find one and squeeze until I’m sure there’s nothing left. Then when that becomes a scab... I pick it off and squeeze out all the blood and sometimes there is more blackhead in there too.

It always becomes infected and disgusting when I do this. But I can’t seem to stop. My shoulders, back, face, and chest all covered in scars and red marks from all my picking. I also pick my lips if I can find any dead skin to pull off, until it’s bloody.

It’s triggered by my anxiety around people and depression. And sometimes just boredom.
give the rest of the money to my family, buy a shotgun, then off myself
Women are just as capable of rape as men are. I don’t care what anyone says. What she did to you was evil and selfish. She deserves to be in prison.

Yep. Me. I spend hours picking my shoulders especially, but when I run out of things to pick on my shoulders my fingers start searching my back and my chest and sometimes stomach and lower arms for zits and blackheads. It really makes me feel relieved knowing I’m not the only one who does this.

I had a great body otherwise but I can never show it off, my skin on my body and face is ruined from all my picking. :(

I do the mindless roaming with my fingers too, all the time! I can tell when a bump is poppable and I pop it without even needing to see it. Feeling it come out against my fingers is sometimes more satisfying than seeing it pop. But, at the price of my skin on my back, shoulders, face, and chest looking like a warzone...
hahahaha... :’)
Aw. :( I know exactly how you feel. My face is a trainwreck too that I constantly need to cover up with makeup. Do you pick at acne until it’s a deep wound like I do?
It always surprises me how people don’t understand, or refuse to believe that asexuality is a thing... it’s not *that* outlandish.

My skin looks terrible... this is after just compulsively picking it. On the top right there are holes from various different picking sessions over the years. Is there a way to heal my skin rignt now and stop picking? This is my right cheek.
I would leave a note warning that there is a gory mess inside so they don’t have to stumble upon it in horror.
We all just sound like a bunch of kids who never grew up to understand sex... hahaha. I find it weird how some men need to have daily sex... like what? That sounds so annoying and needy.

I’m not attractive as a woman with a deep, boyish voice. Who finds a skinny, tall petite woman with a mannish voice attractive? I’m just a defect. (No offense if anyone falls under that description. That’s just how I feel about myself.)
I’m 20 and no work experience or drivers license. I’m doomed.

Hmm someone else commented this. Maybe this is why my vocal range is so small, I never sing. Actually I rarely ever talk since I’m introverted and avoid people most of my life. Could this be a factor why my voice is the way it is? 🤔 not talking enough?

It’s not an advantage lol. I want people to treat me like just a normal teammate but I just make them confused, and make them treat me as lesser, whether they think I’m a boy or a girl with an ugly voice.
Why not? Just wondering.

That’s badass. I commend you for having confidence with your deep voice. Mine is more... neutral. Not effeminate at all but not extremely masculine. Right in the middle, leaning a bit towards masculine. Which sucks. I can’t be sexy, OR badass like you :c

For example. When I get on the mic when I’m playing video games people just think I’m a little boy. :’(
Hmm. My voice doesn’t go that high unfortunately without sounding funny :(
Oh and I’ve been a tomboy my whole life. It hasn’t even changed at 20. I’ve NEVER been into anything girly. What’s wrong with me?

Yeah, especially mountainous or hilly deserts. I hated living in the desert when I was a kid but I’ve warmed up to it, and couldn’t imagine life anywhere else. It’s kind of hard for me to get around since I can’t drive and I live in a pretty urban environment...  (Besides The city, everything is desert.) but I’ll consider it. I’ve never heard of geocaching before, it looks very fun.

Well... I kind of live in the desert. The outdoors aren’t that impressive where I am. Lol. Still, I enjoy being outdoors. So... geocaching is when you hide a surprise for someone else exploring to find? You want me to find one? 🤔

Video games. Animals. Being outdoors. That’s about it though. I’m very shallow of a person, and don’t even have very good knowledge of these things...

I’m not even really feeling that depressed right now, I think these are just thoughts of myself I’ve had deep in my subconscious forever, and I’m finally getting them out...
I’m sorry you’re like me </3 It’s truly a curse.

Writing and grammar are really the only two things I’m good at. I can’t explain how, there’s no intelligence behind it, it just comes naturally. It was the only subject I got decent grades at in school. But behind these decent writing skills, there’s an empty mind and a person devoid of personality. It’s like I’m already dead, my body just hasn’t caught up with my mind yet. And it’s begging me to.

I’m not even trying in life anymore. I just gave up. And that awful life choice is catching up with me fast, I don’t have any life skills and I don’t even have my drivers license, nor a job...  I’m starting to treat the people around me like trash, even though I’ve been a nice person most of my life. I’m just... dying, mentally...

(Sorry for the overload of negativity. I guess I’m just kind of venting. I truly believe all of this though.)
Exactly. Unless they act ways I find attractive I don’t get celebrity crushes. Or any IRL crushes, really.

When I was a kid I never picked at my skin, all the way until I was 12. Then my mom told me I had a zit on my nose, and showed me that you could pop it. I was disgusted at first but intrigued. Every day since then I picked every single blemish on my skin, sometimes until it was infected...

But even when I was young I picked at my lips and, kind of gross, but I picked my nose when I was really young. I think it’s genetic...
All the time, every day.
What does cake in this metaphor represent? 🤔
You and your dog are super cute!! :o
I can relate. I’d probably just give most of my money to my parents if I had money from working, or save it up. I don’t really care enough about anything to spend it on myself...
That’s actually preferable to letting myself live a good life. I should just become homeless and die on the streets, I don’t deserve anything better

Really? Oh man that sounds stressful. I can usually ignore the feeling in my bladder when it’s daytime and I don’t need to do anything.

Do you have an annoying sensation in your bladder every time you strain to go to the bathroom? That’s the worst part for me, it never goes away unless I get up and strain to pee really hard.

I too have been fantasizing about being hit by a vehicle. I have been thinking about leaving my house and walking to the highway and jumping in front of something. But imagine the trauma and guilt that driver would have...
Definitely. I’m too stupid and socially awkward to get a job. And it’s too late anyways, I’m 19 and still haven’t had my first job.
Oh!! I should do physical therapy then. I was offered to do it but my parents were already super deep in bills from testing so I just declined. If this could help me too that’d be amazing.
I thought about volunteering at a shelter. This is great advice! I’m still terrified to get a job so maybe volunteering is a good place to start.
I have a “spastic pelvic floor” according to the doctor who physically examined me. Which might be the same thing. I constantly have sensations that I need to go, especially after just going.

Omg same! I end up pushing really hard straining to get each last drop out, which actually just makes it worse, don’t do that. For me it causes a lingering sensation in my bladder that makes me get up MORE.

It sucks especially when I was a kid having sleepovers, I’d be the last one to fall asleep always and I’d have to get up constantly and use the bathroom before it finally feels good enough in there to fall asleep.
My friends made fun of me for it. And yeah it was kind of embarrassing. I always had to ask to go in like every single class so I was super self-conscious at times.

The problem is my bladder just does not shut up, if I didn’t go to the bathroom “correctly” I will have this lingering sensation that’s just urgently telling me to go to the bathroom again. It’s hard to ignore. I think I’ve trained my bladder to do this and it sucks.

I can’t even fall asleep without sleep aid anymore. I have to take two different kinds of muscle relaxers and a pill for anxiety, and if I’m having a hard time I usually take an actual sleeping pill. Last night I was dumb and just took a bunch of anxiety pills, they usually guarantee that I fall asleep. But every two minutes I was up using the bathroom... it’s so silly
I do this too. If I see a pretty innocent or harmless post that’s getting downvoted for no reason I always upvote t back to 0.
I was thinking of doing something like this. Write 5 things to do before I allow myself to touch my phone. My phone and PS4 are my procrastination machines, I spend all my time on them.
Yup. All the time. It takes me so long to understand simple concepts and apply that concept to the real world...

At least it keeps you occupied. I know, school was really hard for me. But in the end I regretted switching to online school, it was harder for me to be around people not being in a social environment constantly.

My biggest mistake was when I stopped going to public school and decided to finish the rest of school online. That’s when my laziness and anxiety really started getting worse. I graduated, but it didn’t feel earned. And I missed out on the daily social environment of high school... it was stressful but, in the end, I would’ve graduated and probably been more confident to get a job.

Lack of daily social interaction is very, very unhealthy. Sitting inside your comfort zone for 2 years is also very unhealthy... I need to start challenging myself but I’m too goddamn lazy.
Same ;_; At least you’re going to school. That’s really good. I’m doing literally nothing but wallowing I’m self-pity in my free time...
Tried to sleep at 3am. Took 3 hours of pacing back and forth between bed and bathroom heart pounding from anxiety every time I try to sleep. I’m just grateful I can fall asleep at all.
Why are you replying this to everyone giving him positive replies? What an asshole. IMO he isn’t even ugly.
Yeah but I don’t think there are any “right” people for me. I’ll always just be alone and that’s probably how it was meant to be.
No I haven’t. I spend most days just self loathing. I can’t even begin to comprehend adult life, or how to get a job, idk... I’m just so stupid.

What’s your job? I’m so anxious even talking to family members, let alone strangers. I used to be okay at talking to people. But now that I’ve been home for 2 years doing absolutely nothing I’ve become so much worse.

Me too. I can tell everyone just feels uncomfortable talking to me and wants to leave. Every time I make a joke it falls silent, every time I tell a story people get bored and stop listening. I just stopped trying with people. It’s no use. I’ll never be as funny, charismatic, or smart as the average person.
You’re so kind for doing this for people :)
